<noscript>
  <h1>McNaughton–Papert & Schützenberger theorem (1971)</h1>
  <p>A regular language is star-free iff it is definable in first-order logic of linear order FO[<] iff its syntactic monoid is aperiodic. The equivalence characterizes languages without modulo counting.</p>
</noscript>
